deploy-bot: Starting staging deploy for service=infra-inference, env=staging, tag=v2.3.1-rc5, commit=`a1b2c3d`, change-window=03:00-04:00 UTC :rocket:
maya: 🎯 noted. I'll run the smoke suite and watch logs.
raj: pinned config for canary to v2.3.0 fallback before traffic shift, FYI.
simon: quick checklist: healthchecks + latency baseline + reranker sanity. tagging smoke run `smoke/174990`
ops-bot: CI smoke run started: `smoke/174990` · tests=8
deploy-bot: canary nodes up (2/20). shifting 10% traffic to v2.3.1-rc5.
maya: seeing a small p50 uptick (~12ms) on canary, investigating logs.
ops-bot: healthchecks: 5/6 ok, reranker-eval failed on one endpoint — pattern mismatch.
raj: hold traffic shift. rolling back canary to keep stability? or pause and debug?
simon: let's pause. don't rollback yet — gather logs and maybe flip a feature flag.
maya: found a bad tokenization edge in the new tokenizer config, creating a quick patch branch.
raj: if patch looks safe, we can apply hotfix to canary nodes only. I prefer hotfix over full rollback.
deploy-bot: traffic shift paused at 10%. canary instances are pinned at `v2.3.1-rc5` for debugging.
maya: hotfix applied to canary (`a1b2c3d -> a1b2c3d-hotfix1`), restarting canary pods.
ops-bot: canary healthchecks: 6/6 ✅. p50 back to baseline.
simon: running reranker sanity again.
ops-bot: reranker sanity passed on canary. eval diff: 0.3% within threshold.
raj: looks good to me. proceeding with gradual traffic shift to 50% then 100% per rollout policy.
deploy-bot: shifting to 50% → 100% over 5m windows. monitoring enabled.
maya: monitoring dashboards green. cost/latency stable.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy complete: service=infra-inference, tag=v2.3.1-rc5-hotfix1, commit=`a1b2c3d-hotfix1`. Cutover time=00:18. No rollback. :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks team — marking release notes draft for product.
raj: I'll update the changelog with the hotfix note and pin policy in case we need to revert in prod.
simon: closing the staging change window. moving ticket to QA for final signoff.
ops-bot: Deploy summary archived to /releases/staging/1749901111
